summary: Gradient-forward theme tokens and typography were updated, BottomNav active styling and MobileScaffold header visuals were refreshed, and a mobile-wrapper branding README plus icon links in index.html were added. However, the required generated image assets are not evidenced in the diff, and an extra (unrequested) header background image asset is referenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create default mobile branding assets (app icon and splash screen) with the specified filenames/dimensions.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows documentation and references to the images, but does not show the actual PNG files being added anywhere in the repo.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the generated branding images under frontend/public/assets/generated so they can be referenced by static path at runtime.
missing_requirements.reason: No files under frontend/public/assets/generated/ are shown as added/modified in the diff summary (only a README and code changes are shown).

hallucinated_features.description: MobileScaffold now references an additional generated header background image (/assets/generated/header-bg.dim_1600x400.png) that was not requested in the branding asset requirements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only required two generated images (app icon and splash screen). The diff introduces a third generated asset reference.
